name: own-pr-shepherd
description: Own-PR shepherd pass, opt-in: lists the owner's open non-draft PRs in the configured repos (paged to the end, never a --limit cut-off), keeps only PRs whose last non-merge commit is the owner's email, classifies each by its next step and drives it: fix requested changes, ask a reviewer, merge the base in, fix CI this PR broke; an approved PR goes to the owner, never merged or enqueued. Run hourly by the schedule-crons `own-pr-shepherd` entry once the owner enables it. Config-only manifest: OWN_PR_SHEPHERD_REPOS (required; empty = skip), OWN_PR_SHEPHERD_AUTHOR (empty = the signed-in gh login), OWN_PR_SHEPHERD_EMAIL (empty = git config user.email), OWN_PR_SHEPHERD_MIN_QUOTA (GraphQL points floor).
